send.title: Send files with Ferrybox

help.recipients: Up to 50 addresses, separated by commas. To share a link yourself, choose Get a link.
help.expiry: Links last 7 days on Free. On Pro you can choose up to 30 days.

send.done: Sent. We emailed a download link to {{count}} people.

deleteTransfer.title: Delete this transfer?
deleteTransfer.body: The download link stops working at once and the files are deleted for everyone. This frees {{size}} of your storage.

signOut.title: Sign out of Ferrybox?
signOut.body: You can sign in again at any time with your email address.

uploadFailed.title: Upload didn't finish
uploadFailed.body: Something went wrong and {{fileName}} wasn't uploaded (E_UPLOAD_500). Check your internet connection and turn off any VPN, then try again.
